system.description:
When you acquire this skill, select [Male] or [Female]. Change the name of this skill to be like «Nine-Tailed Seduction: Male». You can acquire this skill multiple times, but each time must be under a different name. When you make a [Negotiation Check] opposed by a character with the chosen tag, you gain a +2D bonus to that check. However, if the GM decides this skill isn't valid against the opponent, it cannot be used.

A special skill that allows the negotiation to proceed favorably due to a charm that can be described as magical.
